MK: Risk stratifies the patient’s head injury risk using PECARN prediction tool [GCS, signs of basilar skull fracture, altered mental status, mechanism of injury, vomiting, severe headache, loss of consciousness]
ICS: Discusses management options (CT vs. observation) with parents [speed of diagnosis, radiation, cost, length of stay, need for sedation, potential downsides of incidental findings]
Solicits parent preferences on at least 2 relevant issues [speed of diagnosis, radiation, cost, length of stay, need for sedation, potential downsides of incidental findings]
Incorporates parental preferences into decision making and determines final management plan [suggest play of the case for parent to prefer imaging]
Provides appropriate discharge instructions and return precautions to the parent [imaging results, final diagnosis, return precautions, follow up instructions]
